title: Viveka 2.0
description: We mechanistically interpret efficient and performant architectures on Abstraction Reasoning Corpus and build on top of them. ARC AGI is a benchmark of puzzles that evaluates an AI model's reasoning capabilities that are trivial for humans but hard for current data-hungry AI systems.
tagline: Interpreting and advancing abstract reasoning models

title: Triton :: cu
description: The aim of this project is to make an agentic pipeline capable of converting Triton code into low level CUDA code . CUDA code gives the programmer lower level control and therefore the code can be optimized more than triton code

title: Kath AI
description: Building an Intelligent conversational system for low resource languages by combining retrieval-augmented generation, translation and speech processing. KathAI aims to make collected stories and language resources searchable and accessible while exploring audio cleaning, transcritption , alignment , and speech-based interaction.
